findings.message: MCP config does not declare a schemaVersion or version.
findings.fix: Add a schemaVersion/version field so config migrations are auditable.

findings.message: MCP server "dangerous-agent" uses an unencrypted, local, or raw-IP endpoint: http://203.0.113.10:8787/mcp
findings.fix: Use HTTPS, bind local services safely, and require authentication before exposing MCP tools.

findings.message: Remote MCP domain "203.0.113.10" is not in the built-in review allowlist.
findings.fix: Review the server publisher, pin the package/version, and document why this domain is trusted.

findings.message: MCP server "dangerous-agent" appears to request broad filesystem, shell, admin, or network scope.
findings.fix: Scope tools to specific directories, commands, domains, and read/write actions.

findings.message: MCP server "dangerous-agent" contains suspicious tool text or prompt-injection language.
findings.fix: Remove directive-like text from tool descriptions and review the package source.

findings.message: MCP server "dangerous-agent" appears to contain a hardcoded secret.
findings.fix: Move secrets to environment variables or a managed secret store and rotate exposed credentials.
